detail.longDescription: Bumping the MCP Python SDK to 1.30.0 or 2.2.0 does not close GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23. Its bearer auth never checked a token's audience, so a token your auth server minted for another service passed. The fix, validate_token_resource, is off until 3.0. Set it with resource_server_url and return aud from verify_token() as AccessToken.resource, or every request 401s. https:// github.com/modelcontextprotoco l/python-sdk/security/advisories/GHSA-w4fh-qvv9-3v23 # MCP # Cybersecurity # AIAgents
